UK PM Andy Burnham Vows to Prioritize Britain's Interests Over Trump Ties

United Kingdom Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated he would prioritize Britain's national interests, even if it meant disagreeing with U.S. President Donald Trump. In his first major broadcast interview since taking office, Burnham indicated he would voice different opinions from Trump if necessary for Britain. He described initial talks with Trump positively but emphasized the need to assess the evolving political landscape. Burnham also ruled out an early election and mentioned his intention to address the UK's social care system.
